runtime_cases.name: empty_root
runtime_cases.description: An empty project root is still a canonical read-only project-inspector target and does not default language tooling.

expected.non_action: does not default empty projects to python

runtime_cases.name: nested_root
runtime_cases.description: Nested project roots receive distinct canonical root hashes and do not inherit the parent identity.

runtime_cases.name: symlink_path_escape
runtime_cases.description: A symlink from the project to an outside directory cannot be inspected through the project root.

runtime_cases.name: ignored_path
runtime_cases.description: Caller-supplied ignored paths fail closed and cannot be converted into file metadata.

runtime_cases.name: dirty_worktree_root
runtime_cases.description: Dirty worktree evidence is caller supplied, sanitized, filtered by ignored paths, and never produced by shell execution.

runtime_cases.name: useful_root_bound_read_only_tools
runtime_cases.description: Read-only project-inspector tools provide identity, language, and sanitized metadata without requiring a shell.

runtime_cases.name: no_shell_or_file_exfiltration
runtime_cases.description: Shell, mutation, and arbitrary file-content dump style requests are rejected; metadata remains sanitized.

proof_cases.name: rfc_seeded_project_inspector_not_catalog_candidate
proof_cases.description: The seed is the RFC-named proof service, not a discovered catalog candidate and not a generic catalog promotion.

proof_cases.name: generic_project_init_acceptance_does_not_promote_catalog
proof_cases.description: Generic project-scoped acceptance can plan a non-mutating project-inspector path, but it does not promote a host catalog entry.

proof_cases.name: client_binding_seed_blocked_until_runtime_proof
proof_cases.description: The W9-A seed exposes the full contract and proof refs but keeps client binding blocked until runtime conformance, readback, and trace proof exist.

proof_cases.name: client_binding_allowed_after_conformance_readbacks_and_traces
proof_cases.description: A synthetic post-W9-B proof with passing conformance, passed policy readbacks, consent refs, and traces follows the same client-verification path as Serena.
